observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation console (PS4-style) standing on a store counter; no controller is visible.
Photo 0/1 show the console from different angles; there is visible wear/dust/scratches on the surfaces.
Photo 1 shows the console with another black unit behind it (possibly another console), but the front details/ports are not clearly readable.
No clear model text (e.g., “Pro”) is readable on the console in either photo.
No serial label, HDMI/USB ports close-up, or power-on screen is shown.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console with one controller Pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a PS4-style console, but “PS4 Pro” text and the controller are not visible/readable.

risks.risk: Console may not be PS4 Pro (could be a standard PS4 or another variant).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker and/or the exact “CUH-xxxx” model number on the back/bottom.

risks.risk: Controller may be missing, not included, or not functional (seller says “one controller Pad” but none is shown).
risks.proof: Photo of the included controller (front + back) and a short video showing it pairing/working (buttons responding).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no working controller).

risks.risk: Condition/defects: overheating, noisy fan, disc drive issues, or HDMI/power faults (no power-on test shown).
risks.proof: Short video of power-on to the PS4 home screen and a quick test: audio/video output + controller pairing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case not working properly.

risks.risk: Storage/firmware status unknown (HDD/SSD capacity and whether it boots normally).
risks.proof: Photo of System Settings → Storage and System Information (or a video showing it).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming lowest/unknown storage and no guarantee of smooth operation.

proof_requests: Close-up of the console’s model/serial label (back/bottom) showing the exact CUH model number.
Photo of the included controller (front + back) and confirmation it’s the same unit being sold.
Video: power on to PS4 home screen + controller pairing working.
Photo/video of System Information (firmware version) and Storage capacity.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS4-style console, but they do not clearly prove it is a PS4 Pro and they show no controller or power-on test. Without those, the correct worst-case pricing can’t be set confidently.
